stories.title: Tyga and A.I. in music
stories.summary: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Alex Suskind, news director at Pitchfork, about the artist Tyga's use of AI technology on his new album. Pitchfork rated the album 0.0 out of 10.

stories.title: What caused the migration crisis in Ceuta?
stories.summary: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Maria Munoz Morillo, the Spain bureau chief for Euronews, about what may have prompted thousands of migrants to cross into Spanish territory from Morocco since late July.

stories.title: Arab parties in Israel gear up for major election
stories.summary: Palestinian and Arab minority parties in Israel are gearing up for "the mother of all elections" this fall, as they try to oust a right-wing government they say is racist and a threat to their safety. Their biggest challenge may be divisions amongst themselves, however.

stories.title: Which country has the best jollof rice? A traveling festival aims to find out
stories.summary: One of the most famous dishes across West Africa is Jollof Rice — fragrant rice cooked down with spices, tomatoes and meat. But which version is best? A traveling festival aims to find out.

stories.title: Sailor circumnavigating the Arctic forced to go home
stories.summary: Matt Rutherford set out to be the first person to circumnavigate the Arctic Ocean solo. He says he was force to abandon the journey after the Russian government turned him around.

stories.title: A banned film in India gains popularity
stories.summary: A recent Indian government ban on a film about historical police abuses did not silence the story, it amplified it.
